text:
Maria G.: Quick sync — request from compliance: increase SIEM export retention for prod logs to 540 days for a specific customer during audit window. How do we handle RBAC + KMS unwrap for ad-hoc forensic requests? Need minimal blast radius.
Sam K.: Can we do a scoped export bucket with timeboxed access? prefer ephemeral keys rather than long-lived unwrap.
Jordan T.: +1 scoped bucket. Also need approval workflow: ENGSEC-3801 created. Link: https://jira/redwood/ENGSEC-3801 
Leo P.: For KMS, we can issue a time-limited asymmetric unwrap grant via proxy KMS. That avoids giving analysts direct CMK access.
Ashley R.: Who runs the approval? @security-ops or oncall? Need SLAs for incident triage (1hr unlock target).
Maria G.: @security-ops to approve by default, escalate to SRE lead for >7d retention. For requests under the audit window we can automate with ticket gating.
Sam K.: Technical notes: export pipeline supports per-export TTL and per-destination encryption. We can route compliant exports to a separate bucket with CMK1, and normal exports to CMK2. Then use ephemeral grant on CMK1 when approved.
Sam K.: Example ephemeral unwrap workflow (ops run):
```
# generate ephemeral grant token (proxy service)
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/unlock -d '{"key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/forensics/cryptoKeys/cmk1","ttl_seconds":3600,"ticket":"ENGSEC-3801-123"}'
# proxy returns temporary decrypt token used by export job
```
Jordan T.: We'll need audit logs for every grant (who approved, ticket id, TTL). Can we append grant metadata to the SIEM export manifest?
Leo P.: Yes — manifest will include grant_id, approver, ticket_id, expiry. We should also emit a distinct audit event to the security-audit-log topic.
Ashley R.: One other ask: prod vs staging TTLs should be different. Proposal: staging 30d, non-sensitive prod 90d, sensitive prod (compliance) 540d timeboxed. Approvals required for sensitive.
Maria G.: Sounds good. Also we must avoid leaking PII into long-term buckets. Add redaction step before long-term export.
Sam K.: Good call. We'll add a scrubbed copy for long-term retention. Short-term raw with stricter RBAC.
security-bot: Incident policy reminder: all KMS unwraps must be recorded in ENGSEC-3801 and include a postmortem entry if used for incident response. :warning: 
Jordan T.: Action items: Sam to draft export config (per-destination TTL + CMK mapping) — PR #789, Leo to wire ephemeral grant API and audit events, Ashley to update approval playbook and SLA.
Ashley R.: I'll update the playbook and notify oncall channels. Tagging @oncall for visibility.
Maria G.: Timeline? Can we get an initial PR + playbook update by EOD Wed?
Sam K.: I'll do the PR today. PR #789 created and linked in the ticket.
Leo P.: I'll prototype the proxy endpoint and emit sample audit events by Tue.
Ashley R.: I'll draft the playbook and approval flow by Wed midday.
Maria G.: Thanks — we'll run tabletop for this flow next Friday with SOC and SRE.
Sam K.: one more note: keep export metrics so we can roll back if costs spike.
Maria G.: Agreed. Closing loop later. :thumbsup:
